newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel apologises to Jordan over diplomat.
newsitem.headline: Israel apologises to Jordan over diplomat.

text.p: Israel apologised to Jordan on Sunday over its soldiers' treatment of a Jordanian diplomat at a roadblock on Wednesday, Israel's Itim news agency said.
The Foreign Ministry issued the apology after Jordan made a formal complaint to Israel, Itim said.
The diplomat, who was not identified, said he was detained for five hours at the roadblock although he was in a car with diplomatic plates. He said he was humiliated and insulted, Itim said.
Israel and Jordan signed a peace treaty in 1994 but relations have been rocky since Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ousted Israel's previous dovish government in May 1996 elections.
Jordan's King Hussein has expressed growing frustration with Netanyahu over stalled Middle East peacemaking and has said he is "despairing" of the situation in the Middle East.
